title: psp_helper windowed-dataset meta.json (Core, CONTRACT_VERSION 1.0)
description: Schema for the '<X>.raw.meta.json' sidecar written by save_feature_metadata. Reserved-keys policy: unknown top-level keys are permitted. The 'channels' descriptor (new in Core 1.0) is the PRIMARY, load-bearing channel interface: consumers select channels (observability views, sparse masking, relay ablation) from it, NOT by positional index or by re-parsing feature_names. Channel ORDER is therefore recorded here, never assumed.

feature_names.description: Length must equal shape[2] (f). Human-readable; the structured 'channels' descriptor is authoritative for machine consumption.

channels.description: Per-channel structured descriptor, index-aligned with feature_names / the f axis. Enables relay/bus/line/phase/quantity selection without positional or name-parsing assumptions.

cubicle.description: Stable cubicle/relay key; the 6 channels of one cubicle share it and are contiguous.

quantity.description: Physical quantity: current or voltage. Naming tokens vary by profile (cur/vol, Isec/Usec); this normalized field does not.

feature_groups.description: Named index groups. At minimum SHOULD include 'currents' and 'voltages'; MAY include per-cubicle/per-bus/per-line groups. Consumers (e.g. the DL benchmark) select feature subsets from here.
